[SWS_DM_00950] Configuration of DTC priority as extended data record
⌈
If the configuration parameter DiagnosticProvidedDataMapping.dat-
aProvider of the corresponding DiagnosticParameter.dataElement is set to
DEM_PRIORITY, the DM shall set the value of this internal data element to the
DTC priority assigned by DiagnosticTroubleCodeProps.priority for this DTC.
The length of this internal data element is one byte.
⌋

[SWS_DM_00950] Configuration of DTC priority as extended data record
⌈
If the DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordElement is referenced by Diagnos-
ticEdrDataProviderMapping.extendedDataRecordElement and Diagnos-
ticEdrDataProviderMapping.dataProvider is set to DEM_DTC_PRIORITY,
